method: git cat-file --batch compares all pre-existing runtime/data/inventory/asset-package/dependency sources to the reviewed baseline. Binary files require exact bytes; text-only CRLF normalization is identified separately. This is a scoped source/integration audit, not a physical-device or external-human review.
auditHelperDevelopment: Two initial helper runs stopped before writing a report because they assumed assets/families keys. The helper now reads the canonical entries array; no game or validator source changed.

reviewed: Immediate Continue uses the existing explicit acknowledge transaction once; elapsed time and Skip never invoke progression.
StoryPresentation has no timer or asynchronous callback after cancellation; its monotonic frame sampling stops when settled/cancelled.
World temporary animal/head transforms restore from saved originals each frame and on clear/disposal. No state, capacity, tide, heading history or geometry mutation supplies the gesture.
Reduced/background/restored paths settle at complete endpoint poses without forcing the normal world into Reduced Motion.
Current native dialog, fullscreen owner, single Sound owner and actual audio intent remain; no acknowledgment calls arrival audio.
Gameplay entry clears temporary presentation before disposing and recreating its existing puzzle world. Normal paths remain inactive while storyJob is null.
Dialog render centrally removes the story-caption class outside story mode; no reading-panel grid leaks into passenger previews.
limits: This audit does not run another browser or infer creative acceptance. Actual scene captures and checks are reported separately.
Earlier card/dock overlap, delivered-heading and rapid-touch limits remain open; no physical Android, native-GPU, alternate-font or new listening approval.
